resolutions.researcher_notes: Status 'operating' confirmed. Egyptian Petroleum Ministry (28 Dec 2022) lists 'خط التينة غرب / ميت نما / الشرقاوية بطول 168 كم' among gas transmission lines COMPLETED in 2022. GASCO 2023 annual report (via Masrawy, 4 Mar 2024) states the final phase / doubling of the El Tina West-Mit Nama line was completed and 'gas pumped into the line' (تدفيع الغاز بالخط) during 2023. Operating is inferable from completion + gas flow. Government-linked but separate publications/events.

StartYear1=2022 supported: the Petroleum Ministry's 28 Dec 2022 statement lists the El Tina West/Mit Nama/El Sharqawiya 168 km line among lines completed/entered service in 2022. CONTRADICTION TO FLAG: GASCO's 2023 report (Masrawy, Mar 2024) says the doubling/final phase of the same line was only completed in 2023 with gas pumped that year - so this is a phased project (main line 2022, doubling 2023); a StartYear2=2023 for the doubling may be warranted. 2022 is defensible for first service.

Delayed=yes / DelayType=confirmed supported by Al-Watan (11 Jan 2022): 'البترول تقرر مد العمل في مشروع خط غاز ميت نما لمدة 18 شهرا' - the Petroleum Ministry decided to EXTEND work on the Mit Nama gas line by 18 months, an explicitly confirmed schedule slip. Single strong Arabic source; could not locate a fully independent second report on the 18-month extension. WebFetch is 403-walled on elwatannews but url_verifier confirms the page is live (200) and contains the '18' / ميت نما tokens.

LengthKnown=170 km appears in Youm7 (10 May 2022) for the El Tina West-Mit Nama line (planning figure). CONTRADICTION TO FLAG: as-built/completion sources give shorter lengths - Petroleum Ministry (Dec 2022) 168 km; GASCO 2023 report (Masrawy) 167 km (main line) and 168 km (doubling). 170 is the early planning number; as-built is 167-168 km. Recommend Update review the value toward 167-168.

Route El Tina/التينة غرب (Port Said) -> Mit Nema/ميت نما (Al Qalyubia) confirmed by Youm7 (التينة غرب - ميت نما) and the Petroleum Ministry (خط التينة غرب / ميت نما / الشرقاوية). Mit Nama is in Qalyubia governorate; El Tina is in Port Said. MINOR FLAG: the ministry lists the line as El Tina West -> Mit Nama -> El Sharqawiya, i.e. it may extend past Mit Nama; GEM's EndLocation=Mit Nema captures only the named mid-terminus.

The figure 3,335,000,000 EGP ('3 مليار و 335 مليون جنيه') is confirmed by egy-map.com and the Egyptian Presidency projects portal - but BOTH attribute it to the 'El Tina - Abu Sultan - Administrative Capital' line (165 km, 42in, Cairo/Ismailia/Port Said), a DIFFERENT/adjacent line, not El Tina->Mit Nama. STRONG CONTRADICTION TO FLAG: the El Tina West->Mit Nama line's own cost is reported at ~4 billion EGP (GASCO 2023 report, Masrawy) and ~4.5 billion EGP (Youm7 / Egypt Oil & Gas). GEM appears to have imported the Abu Sultan/Capital line's cost onto the Mit Nama row - likely a conflation of two related El Tina lines. The two cited sources share the presidency project DB (not truly independent).

Owner1=Egyptian Natural Gas Holding Co (EGAS) supported by Egypt Oil & Gas: 'Under the supervision of EGAS, GASCO is pursuing the implementation...' - EGAS (the holding company) is the owning/overseeing entity while its subsidiary GASCO (Egyptian Natural Gas Company) executes and operates. Consistent with Owner=EGAS. NOTE: the operating entity is GASCO (per Petroleum Ministry and GASCO's own 2023 report); if an Operator field exists it should read GASCO, not EGAS.
